messages:
tess-cs: Starting Crimson dedicated bring-up thread. Need final quota, autoscale profile, loadtest window, and a short customer-facing runbook. Renewal team flagged this account.

ryan-ops: Committed quota = 1,300 qps. Proposal: autoscale min=150 target=700 max=1300 step=100 cooldown=60s. Smooth ramp for chat workloads.

alex-eng: Suggest 1) 8h shadow replay to warm KV cache, 2) 30m steady at 700 qps, 3) three bursts: 900, 1100, 1300 qps for 4m each with 6m recovery. Prefer Wed 05:00 UTC.

mira-ml: We'll enable prefix caching + async KV warm. Primary model: gpt-small-q on pool-E with fallback to fp16. Expect ~12% effective qps reduction after warmup.

harry-fin: Please include token-cost delta for steady vs bursts in the post-test report for renewal.

tess-cs: Customer SLO: p95 < 240ms steady, no visible error spikes. Need explicit rollback criteria I can share.

alex-eng: Rollback triggers: error_rate >0.9% for 4m OR p95 >450ms for 5m. On trigger: abort bursts, route to hosted fallback, and notify #oncall + cs@redwood.

ryan-ops: I'll add a tenant-protect throttle and temporary ingress cap for the test window. Also pre-authorize fallback with oncall.

alex-eng: k6 commands (will use a shadow key):

```\n// shadow warmup\nk6 run --vus 700 --duration 8h replay-warm.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated.crimson.redwood/v1/chat\n// steady\nk6 run --vus 700 --duration 30m steady.js\n// bursts\nk6 run --vus 900 --duration 4m burst1.js\nk6 run --vus 1100 --duration 4m burst2.js\nk6 run --vus 1300 --duration 4m burst3.js\n```\n
mira-ml: Dashboards to share: poolE_p95_latency, poolE_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, fallback_count, scaling_events, tokens_per_minute. I'll post permalinks after setup.

harry-fin: ETA for cost breakdown?

ryan-ops: Post-test report next morning: p50/p95/p99, error taxonomy, token-cost delta, scaling events, and any fallback traces.

tess-cs: Action items: Alex run test Wed 05:00 UTC; Ryan apply autoscale knobs + guardrails; Mira prep dashboards and permalinks; Alex+Ryan deliver post-test report; I'll brief customer after steady phase.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-variant/gpt-small-q -> pool-E at 1789999300 :white_check_mark:

alex-eng: I'll redact keys in artifacts and attach grafana links + logs to this thread after the run.

ryan-ops: I'll also set a temporary global throttle to protect other tenants during bursts.

tess-cs: Thanks team. Please keep anything internal out of the customer brief. Focus renewal notes on p95/p99 and error classifications.
